transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because I know the new owners of the bar are out to destroy my name, no matter what anyone else says. They are actively trying to ruin my reputation and my career, and I need people to understand that this is actually happening.
Have you experienced any other thoughts or beliefs that you think are being controlled or influenced by external forces, such as the government, media, or other people?

No, nothing like that with the government or the media, I don't have those kinds of thoughts. My focus is strictly on the new owners and that younger manager who are actively calling around to ruin my name and sabotage my reputation.
Have you ever had a period where you didn't believe the new owners of the bar were out to get you, or has this feeling been constant since it started?

Before these past two months, I never had these thoughts or felt this way at all. But once I fell into this dark, drained state about two months ago, it became constant. I am absolutely certain they are actively trying to destroy my reputation.
Have you taken any actions or made any decisions based on your belief that the new owners of the bar are trying to ruin your reputation, such as confronting them or changing your daily routine?

Yes, I confronted the owners directly about sabotaging me, and they ended up sending me home mid-shift. Since then, I've been so stressed that I've missed several work shifts, stopped going to my running group and volunteering, and even let my chores pile up at home because I just don't have the energy.

Can you describe any other unusual experiences or perceptions you've had during these past two months, such as hearing voices or seeing things that others don't, or feeling like you have special powers or insights?

No, I don't hear any voices or see things that aren't there, and I don't have any special powers. The only thing going on is what I know for a fact: the new owners and that younger manager are actively conspiring to ruin my reputation. They are calling around to other bars and my photography clients to make sure I never get hired again.

Can you think of any evidence or events that have happened in the past two months that you think prove the new owners are trying to ruin your reputation, or is this based on your intuition and feelings about the situation?

It’s not just some feeling or intuition; I am absolutely certain of it. The new owners and that younger manager are quietly calling other bars and even my photography clients to spread lies so no one will hire me. People tell me I'm being paranoid, but they just don't see what is happening behind the scenes.

Have you considered the possibility that the new owners and the younger manager might not actually be trying to ruin your reputation, and that your beliefs about their actions could be a misunderstanding or misinterpretation of their intentions?

No, there is absolutely no way this is a misunderstanding. I am completely certain they are trying to destroy my reputation and ruin my career. Other people simply don't see what is actually happening behind the scenes.

Can you tell me more about what specifically led you to believe that the new owners and the younger manager are calling around to ruin your reputation, and have you noticed any changes in your thoughts or behaviors over the past two months that seem unusual to you or others?

I know they are doing it behind the scenes because suddenly my photography clients and other bars stopped getting back to me right after they cut my hours. It all started two months ago when I fell into this dark, hopeless state, and I stopped running, volunteering, and keeping up with my apartment. My friends noticed how much my behavior changed and that I was struggling, which is why one of them finally brought me here.

You mentioned feeling in a 'dark, hopeless state' and 'drained' over the past two months. Can you describe how your mood has been during this time, and have you experienced any feelings of sadness, emptiness, or loss of interest in activities you normally enjoy?

For the last two months, I’ve been stuck in this incredibly dark, drained mood where everything feels completely hopeless. I’ve lost all interest in the things I used to live for, like busy nights behind the bar, planning photo shoots, and trail running. Even thinking about those things feels pointless now, like all the color has been sucked out of my life.
You mentioned losing interest in activities you used to enjoy, can you tell me more about when this loss of interest started and how it has affected your daily life?

This loss of interest started about two months ago, and now things I used to love like photography, trail running, and busy nights at the bar feel pointless, like all the color has been sucked out. It's completely disrupted my life—I've stopped volunteering at the community kitchen, stopped showing up to my running group, and let my apartment get messy with dishes and laundry piling up.
Have you experienced any periods where your belief about the new owners trying to ruin your reputation seemed less convincing or less intense, or has it remained constant over the past two months?

No, it hasn't wavered or felt any less intense at all. Ever since this dark period started two months ago, I have been absolutely convinced and certain that they are out to destroy me. Nothing anyone says to me has made it feel any less real.

Have you ever had moments where you doubted your belief that the new owners are trying to ruin your reputation, even if just for a brief moment, or has your conviction remained unwavering the entire time?

I have never doubted it for a single second, and my conviction has been completely unwavering. When people tell me I'm being paranoid, I just realize they don't see the behind-the-scenes reality of what is actually happening. I know for a fact they are trying to ruin me, and nothing will change that.
Have you experienced any other delusional thoughts or beliefs about other people or situations beyond the new owners of the bar trying to ruin your reputation?

No, I don't have any other thoughts like that about other people. My focus is strictly on the new owners and the younger manager who are actively working to ruin my reputation. I don't feel like anyone else in my life is out to get me.

Can you describe how your feelings of hopelessness and loss of interest in activities relate to your belief that the new owners are trying to ruin your reputation, or do these feelings seem separate to you?

They are deeply connected; I only became absolutely certain they were sabotaging me after I had already fallen into this dark, drained state where I lost interest in everything. The hopelessness and lack of energy definitely came first, and then the belief about them ruining my reputation took over. It felt like once my life lost all its color, that's when I realized what they were doing to me behind the scenes.

Can you estimate how much of your daily thoughts are occupied by your belief that the new owners are trying to ruin your reputation, and has this preoccupation been constant or has it varied over the past two months?

These thoughts occupy almost all of my daily mental energy, and it has been completely constant. I even snap awake at three or four in the morning with my mind immediately racing about how they are ruining my name. It has been like this consistently for the past two months since I fell into this dark, hopeless state.
Have you ever had any other fixed beliefs that you considered true, but others did not, before this situation with the new owners of the bar?

No, I have never had any beliefs like that before in my life. I only started being convinced they were sabotaging me after I had already sunk into this dark, drained state where everything felt hopeless. Before these last two months, my mind never worked this way at all.

Can you tell me if you think your belief about the new owners ruining your reputation would still be as strong if you were feeling better emotionally and had more energy, or do you think this belief is separate from your mood?

They definitely feel connected, because I never had these thoughts about them sabotaging me before my mood and energy completely tanked. This absolute certainty about them ruining my name only started after I sank into this dark, hopeless state. Even though it still feels completely real to me right now, the timing makes me think they are tied together.
Do you think your belief about the new owners trying to ruin your reputation would change if your mood and energy levels improved?

Even though these thoughts only started after I fell into this dark, exhausted state, the sabotage is completely real and not just a trick of my mood. I really doubt that having more energy or feeling better would change anything, because the evidence that they are actively ruining my name is just too real to ignore.

If your mood were to significantly improve and you started enjoying your activities again, do you think your belief about the new owners trying to ruin your reputation would weaken or remain the same?

It would remain exactly the same because their sabotage is a real fact, not just a symptom of my bad mood. Even though these thoughts only started after I fell into this dark state, feeling better wouldn't change what they are actually doing behind my back. I am absolutely certain it is happening in reality, regardless of how I feel.

You've mentioned that your belief about the new owners trying to ruin your reputation started after you fell into a dark, hopeless state. Can you clarify if this belief has been present every day since then, or have there been days where it felt less intense or you didn't think about it as much?

Yes, it has been present every single day without fail since this started. It is always on my mind, especially when I snap awake in the middle of the night with my heart racing. There hasn't been a single day where I felt safe or doubted that they are actively trying to destroy me.

Have you ever experienced any brief moments, even if just for a few seconds, where you questioned the reality of the new owners trying to ruin your reputation, or has your belief in their sabotage been unwavering at all times?

I have never doubted it for a single second; my belief has been completely unwavering the entire time. The signs are just too clear for me to ever question what is happening behind the scenes. I am absolutely certain they are trying to ruin me, no matter what anyone else says.

You've had this belief for two months without doubting it, but can you think of any situation or event that could potentially change your mind about the new owners trying to ruin your reputation, or do you think nothing could ever make you question this belief?

Absolutely nothing could ever change my mind or make me question it. I am completely certain they are sabotaging me, and even if people try to convince me otherwise, they just don't see the behind-the-scenes actions that I know are happening.
Can you describe how your daily life and interactions with others have been affected by your constant preoccupation with the belief that the new owners are trying to ruin your reputation?

It has completely taken over my life—I've missed work shifts, got sent home after confronting them, and stopped going to my running group and volunteering entirely. I've shut out my friends because they keep telling me I'm paranoid and they just don't understand what's happening behind the scenes. Now, I mostly stay isolated in my apartment while dishes and laundry pile up because I have absolutely no energy left to deal with anything.
Have you ever considered that your belief about the new owners trying to ruin your reputation could be a delusion, and if so, how do you think that would change your understanding of the situation?

I don't think this is a delusion at all, and it honestly wears me down that people keep calling it that or saying I'm paranoid. I am absolutely certain of what the owners are doing, and it is a completely real, factual situation to me. Other people just don't see what is actually happening behind the scenes.
If you were to discover concrete evidence, such as a recording or a witness, that proved the new owners were not trying to ruin your reputation, would this change your belief about their intentions?

No, that wouldn't change my mind at all because they are far too clever and would easily fake something like that to cover their tracks. Anyone else simply doesn't see what is actually happening behind the scenes. No matter what anyone says or what "evidence" is presented, I know they are out to destroy me.

Can you think of any situation where you might consider the possibility, even if small, that your belief about the new owners could be exaggerated or not entirely accurate, or do you think this is absolutely impossible for you to consider?

It is absolutely impossible for me to consider that, because my belief isn't exaggerated or inaccurate at all. I am one hundred percent convinced the new owners are actively trying to destroy my reputation and career. Other people simply don't see what is happening behind the scenes, but I know the truth.
Can you think of any situation or event in the past two months where your belief about the new owners was less intense or you didn't think about it as much, or has it been constant and unchanging?

No, it has been completely constant and unchanging over the past two months. There hasn't been a single moment where it felt less intense or where I doubted it, because I am absolutely certain of what they are doing behind the scenes. It occupies my mind every single day.

If your mood were to improve significantly and you started enjoying activities again, but you still had no evidence that the new owners had stopped trying to ruin your reputation, do you think the intensity of your belief about their sabotage would decrease at all?

No, the intensity wouldn't decrease at all because my mood has absolutely nothing to do with the reality of what they are doing. Even if I felt happier and went back to my hobbies, it wouldn't change the fact that they are actively trying to ruin my reputation behind the scenes. This is a real situation happening in the real world, not just a symptom of me being depressed.

Do you think that if the new owners of the bar were to publicly announce that they have no intention of ruining your reputation and were to offer you your job back, this would change your belief about their intentions?

No, that wouldn't change my mind at all because an announcement or a job offer would just be a calculated trap to make themselves look good. It is nothing more than a cover-up to hide the sabotage they are still carrying out behind the scenes. Absolutely nothing they say or do will change my mind because I know the truth about what is really happening.

Can you tell me if you think your life would have any meaning or purpose if the new owners of the bar were to stop trying to ruin your reputation, or if that would not change your overall feelings of hopelessness and despair?

Even if they stopped, it wouldn't change this deep hopelessness because I fell into this dark, drained state before any of this even started. Honestly, I feel like I deserve to be punished anyway for all my failures and mistakes, and everything in my life still feels completely pointless and empty.
